fact: BoFiNet, the state-owned fibre company, says that at the end of financial year 2022/23 it had partnered with four local authorities (Bobirwa Sub District Council, Boteti Sub District Council, Serowe District Council and Mahalapye District Council) for the deployment of premises Wi-Fi in Rural Administration Centres; it states a partnership for deployment, not that the Wi-Fi was live, and gives no use.
title: Botswana Fibre Networks 2023 Annual Report
